text:
ben: heads-up from today's entitlement delta: ~132 orphaned admin grants popped up after sync. short report: https://internal/reports/ent/4920 :mag:
sec-bot: alert: orphaned_grants=132 stale_cutoff_days=90 severity=medium rule=orphan-ent-detect
olga: oof. any KMS keys in that set?
ben: yes ~20 KMS-related bindings. also ~40 svc-* principals used by periodic jobs. sample lines:
```
grant: 0xfeed svc-ingest-scheduler -> infra-admin last_used=2025-10-18 owner=null
grant: 0xfee1 olga.old@oldco -> org-admin last_used=null owner=null
grant: 0xfee2 kms-auto-rotate -> kms-admin last_used=2026-01-12 owner=null
```
ryan: we need a low-blast plan. propose: 1) tag as "sec:orph-4920" for tracking, 2) populate a quarantine view for SRE/Platform, 3) start owner-claim emails (TTL=7d), 4) for svc accounts with last_used>180d apply a "deny:token:mint" guard, but DO NOT change KMS bindings until manual mapping.
olga: +1. add requirement: any change touching kms-admin must have platform-oncall approval and an ops PR with rollback steps. also add CloudTrail filter so any grant-change emits remediation_ticket and actor.
ben: command I used to tag a grant (internal):
```bash
entctl tag --grant 0xfeed --tag sec:orph-4920 --reason "delta-orphan-scan-2026-03"
```
ryan: canary idea: pick 10 non-KMS svc grants (low-traffic), tag + apply deny-token-mint for 48h, monitor cron success rate and error spikes. if <1% job error and no pager, proceed to phased remediation.
platform-oncall: noted. platform approval required for KMS edits. please DM oncall before making policy changes.
sec-bot: incident created INC-4920 (orphan-ent-delta). channel #inc-4920 provisioned.
olga: I'll prepare the canary manifest and comms templates. ryán, can you add the smoke-tests that validate rotated svc creds? (3 runs, success >=99%)
ryan: will add smoke harness. sample rotation snippet for service accounts:
```bash
# create rotated service account with least-priv template
svcctl create-sa --from-grant 0xfeed --roles infra-job-minimal --test-run 3
```
ben: timeline: canary kickoff 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC, 48h window, then review and expand to ~200 grants over a week if green.
olga: I'll include a section in the runbook to rebind cron principals as rollback if we see failures. also adding a step to check key policies before any KMS changes.
sec-bot: reminder set: incident follow-up in 72h.
ben: next actions: olga -> canary list & comms, ryan -> smoke-tests & rotation draft, ben -> incident lead + audit artifacts. tagging @olga @ryan :thumbsup:
olga: posting canary manifest in incident channel in 30m. :hourglass:
